Subtracting 350 days from 1096-08-12.  
1096 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and not a century year in this case).  
From 1096-08-12 back 350 days:  
Go back 12 days → 1096-07-31, back 31 more days → 1096-06-30, back 30 more days → 1096-05-31, back 31 more days → 1096-04-30, back 30 more days → 1096-03-31, back 31 more days → 1096-02-29 (leap year), back 29 more days → 1096-01-31, back 31 more days → 1095-12-31.  
Remaining days: 350 - (12+31+30+31+30+31+29+31+31) = 350 - 256 = 94 days left to subtract from 1095-12-31.  
Back 31 days → 1095-11-30, back 30 days → 1095-10-31, back 31 days → 1095-09-30, remaining 94 - (31+30+31) = 2 days.  
Back 2 more days from 1095-09-30 → 1095-09-28.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1095-09-28
